Join the Nassau-Suffolk (NY) Alumni Chapter Kappa Alpha Psi Fraternity Inc. and the Lakeview Public Library for a FREE community event, From our History to Their Future focusing on literacy, history and service. Books, open minds. Service builds brighter tomorrows. The event will feature a children's read-aloud and interactive discussion from 10- 12 PM. There will be a history book dedication and presentation of The Story of Kappa Alpha Psi, Sixth Edition to the library in memory of late brother Jack Fitzgerald Prophet at appox 12 PM. There will also be a service drive in partnership with Luggage For Love. They are collecting items to support children and youth in foster care and families in transition. Items collected are new luggage and duffel bags for youth in foster care through Nassau County DSS and gently used luggage for immigrant children and families in transition.
